body.html: Rimpao Hotel sits at 71/2 Kut Yang Samakkhi Road, Tambon Kalasin, Mueang Kalasin District — right in the centre, with easy access for food and errands. It's a roughly 140-room hotel that has been part of Kalasin town for years, known as the main venue for banquets, weddings and meetings in town. There's an outdoor pool, a Chinese restaurant, a karaoke room, airport transfer and free parking for travellers who want full facilities in one place.

What guests praise most is the central location and the spacious rooms. Many reviews mention airy rooms with cool air-con, strong water pressure, and a price that's easy on the wallet for what you get. The pool earns praise too, especially from families with children, who often say it's clean and easy to enjoy. Several staff get singled out as friendly and helpful. For anyone in town on errands or attending a function at the hotel, it's a convenient base that's good value.
"Roomy with cool air-con and strong water pressure, right in the centre so getting around is easy, and a pool the kids could enjoy — just be ready for an older building and a few dated fittings."

Another thing that sets Rimpao apart from other places in town is having full facilities for a provincial in-town hotel. There's an on-site Chinese restaurant, large banquet and meeting rooms, a karaoke room and a relaxing spa. Free, roomy parking makes it easy for self-drivers, and the central location puts markets, restaurants and government offices just a few minutes' walk or drive away — handy for both leisure and business travellers.

Now the honest part — this is a long-established hotel and the building is showing its age, with some areas lacking upkeep. Some reviews note dated rooms and common areas, old TVs, original bathrooms, sagging beds in some rooms, and plumbing or musty-smell issues here and there. Breakfast is simple, and a few guests say the choice is smaller than expected. Some listed facilities aren't open at all times, and staff speak limited English. It suits a stay where you're not expecting something new or luxurious.

In short, Rimpao Hotel suits travellers who want a central Kalasin base with full facilities like a pool and restaurant, and easy errands in town. The overall score of around 7.6 from real reviews reflects it fairly — good location, roomy rooms, a pool, accessible price, but an aging building and uneven attention to detail. Set your expectations to the price and lean on the convenience of the central location, and it's still a genuinely usable choice in Kalasin.

faq.q: Where is Rimpao Hotel in Kalasin?
faq.a: It's at 71/2 Kut Yang Samakkhi Road, Tambon Kalasin, Mueang Kalasin District, right in the heart of Kalasin town. It's about a 5-minute walk to Kut Nam Kin Public Park and a few minutes' drive to the central mosque and bus station, making errands in town easy.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Rooms start at around ฿490/night for a Standard Room with two twin beds. There's a Deluxe around ฿650, a Junior Suite around ฿1,100 and a Presidential Suite around ฿2,200. Prices vary by season — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Rimpao Hotel have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — there's an outdoor pool that families with children praise as clean and easy to enjoy, something other places in Kalasin town often lack. There's also a Chinese restaurant, banquet and meeting rooms, karaoke, a spa and free parking.

The strength is roomy rooms with cool air-con and strong water pressure. But it's a long-established hotel and the building is aging — some reviews mention old TVs, original bathrooms, sagging beds or a musty smell in certain rooms, so check the room at check-in and tell the front desk.
Yes — there's free parking, and the central location makes it an easy drive in and out for food and errands. There's also an airport transfer service for those not driving.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a central Kalasin base with full facilities like a pool and restaurant, and easy errands in town. It's less suited to anyone who needs a fresh property with fully up-to-date fittings and consistent attention to detail.
